page.overview:
What is The New Song?

The New Song (or it's alternate title Death is Not the End) is a song that Metallica played during the Escape from the Studio '06 tour. It contains riffs that would later be on The End of the Line, All Nightmare Long, and Cyanide.

The song tells a story about change and accepting death. It begins with a character, the man in black, representing the darkness that surrounds life. The chorus urges people to open up and welcome the spirit, expressing that death is not the conclusion but a fresh start. As time goes by, family and friends come together to bid farewell, highlighting the significance of saying goodbye. The narrator thinks back on their life as a wanderer and risk-taker, implying that light offers liberation. In the end, it shows that the man in black transforms into light, encouraging one to release their former self.

It has been played for a total of four times in June 2006.

The man in black comes around He blacks the light, he blacks the sound Just far enough, he takes from here, to rise above the myth of fear Then lay your soul in life not found
